existing_conditions.use: Only Acne, Dark Spot, and Rosacea as weak cosmetic labels after review
existing_conditions.reason: Medical folder labels, source provenance unavailable, and substantial cross-source duplication

existing_types.reason: Only 112 images and image-only skin type is outside the revised scope

existing_clean_train.reason: Repeated stock imagery, pre-generated augmentation, and leakage into the named validation set

existing_clean_val.reason: Not an independent validation set; duplicates and source overlap invalidate it

facial_skin_concerns.use: Weak-label candidate pool for all five concerns
facial_skin_concerns.reason: Useful label coverage, but no upstream provenance and visible label noise/watermarks

skin_issues_v2.use: Review and external evaluation only until licensing is clarified
skin_issues_v2.reason: Unknown license, repeated subjects, and extensive overlap with other Kaggle collections

rajesh_skin.reason: Repeated Getty/stock images, weak provenance, duplicate train/val content, and invalid skin-type labels

pascal_voc_2007.reason: Established object-recognition benchmark with animal, vehicle, and indoor-object annotations

ffhq_wrinkle.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (FFHQ-Wrinkle masks and FFHQ images; non-commercial, attribution)
ffhq_wrinkle.use: fine_lines only: 1,000 manual wrinkle masks, tertiles of wrinkle-pixel coverage mapped to absent/unknown/present
ffhq_wrinkle.reason: Positives and negatives from one source break the wrinkles-folder shortcut; coverage is also reduced by occlusion (glasses, hats), so labels are noisy

memi_ds.license: CC BY 4.0 (attribution: Zhai, Zhenwei (2025). MEMI-DS. figshare. https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.29209229.v1)
memi_ds.use: dark_spots positives only, training only: a non-empty melasma mask maps to dark_spots=1; other concerns stay unknown
memi_ds.reason: Melasma is one kind of facial hyperpigmentation; every photo is a positive taken with the same clinical rig (eye bar, chin rest), so the source cannot supply negatives and risks a setup shortcut
